description.value: Inn Towne Motel is a mountain-setting motel in Hope, BC, situated along the Trans-Canada Highway close to Coquihalla Canyon Provincial Park and the Othello Tunnels. Rooms are individually furnished and range from standard kings to pet-friendly double queens and kitchenette suites — practical options for cyclists who need to do laundry or cook after a long day. The property also features a Jacuzzi and swimming pool, and guest reviews consistently praise the cleanliness and hospitality of the hands-on management.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and consistently identifies the property at 510 Trans-Canada Hwy, Hope, BC V0X 1L0, which conflicts with OSM's address of '510 Water Avenue' — this discrepancy is flagged below. The website confirms free WiFi and lists 'Laundry & Ironing' as a motel facility; it also references nearby restaurants. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records '510 Water Avenue' but the website consistently lists '510 Trans-Canada Hwy, Hope, BC V0X 1L0' across all pages. The website address has been used as primary; OSM should be corrected.
Name mismatch: OSM records 'Inntowne Motel' (one word) but the website uses 'Inn Towne Motel' (two words) throughout.
OSM has no phone number; phone (604) 869-7276 sourced from website only.
Community field shows 'Unknown / Lower Mainland & Fraser Valley' but Hope, BC is in the Fraser Canyon — may need community reassignment.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating motel in Hope, BC with a live website, booking functionality, and recent guest reviews. Straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Canyon.
